summary: Builds a curve from data produced by an Inverse Curve CHOP, turning channel data back into SOP curve geometry.

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: Inverse Curve CHOP whose data reconstructs the curve.

common_gotchas: Arbitrary CHOP channels are not sufficient; the source must be compatible Inverse Curve CHOP data.
Use this when a workflow intentionally converted curve geometry through Inverse Curve CHOP.
Mismatched sample/channel layout can reconstruct a curve that does not match the original.
key_concepts: Inverse Curve SOP builds a curve from data produced by an Inverse Curve CHOP.
It is a specialized curve round-trip operator, not a general CHOP-to-curve converter.
The official page documents one operator parameter, `chop`, for the Inverse Curve CHOP source.
Validate channel layout before expecting the reconstructed curve to match the source curve.
